description: Returns the full record for one known person, matched by email or by name with a company name, number or domain. It spends 1 credit only on a confident match, and 0 on no match or when you already hold the record under licence, so a repeat never charges twice. Like create_order it needs the user's confirmation (a form, or the confirmation_token from an approval_url) or an agent key whose allowed_tools include enrich_contact within its per-order cap and monthly budget; otherwise nothing is charged and it returns confirmation-required or agent-budget-exceeded. It needs enrich:write; use it for a single named person, and the result gives credits_charged and the balance left. Lawful basis is UK GDPR Article 6(1)(f) legitimate interests; email audiences include corporate subscribers only by default (PECR), so sole traders and ordinary partnerships are left out unless the toggle is changed.

inputSchema.description: One known person to match. Send email, or first_name and last_name with company_name, company_number or domain.

company_number.description: Eight characters in upper case, such as 05046417 or SC123456.

confirmation_token.description: The token the approval page on mydatahub.emailmovers.com returns once the signed-in person approves. It is bound to that person (their sub), this spend (the machine quote_id, or the enrichment or push) and an expiry no later than the quote's, and it is redeemable once.

name: enrich_contact

ComplianceObject.description: Carried by every preview row, order record, lookup and enrichment, and repeated as CSV columns and as the MyDataHub property group on CRM push.

examples.attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0

attribution.description: The OGL v3.0 attribution for Companies House company data. Officer names are personal data outside the OGL, so they carry article14_status instead.

corporate_subscriber.description: True for companies, LLPs, Scottish partnerships and public bodies, where the PECR regulation 22 consent rule does not apply.

lawful_basis.description: UK GDPR Article 6(1)(f) legitimate interests, with the LIA in lia_ref.

record_age_days.description: Days since the record was compiled.

subscriber_class.description: PECR subscriber class: ltd, plc, llp, scottish_partnership, public_body, charity_incorporated, sole_trader, ordinary_partnership, unknown.

tps_ctps_screened_at.description: The date of the screen the status is as of; null when not screened.

tps_ctps_status.description: Telephone screen: clear, tps_registered, ctps_registered, tps_or_ctps_registered, not_screened. The result of the screen on tps_ctps_screened_at, valid until tps_ctps_valid_until. In a sample, an order's records (each time they are fetched, downloaded or pushed) and an enrichment, a clear number reads not_screened, with no dates, once that screen is more than 28 days before the day the record is served; a registered number stays registered.

tps_ctps_valid_until.description: 28 days after tps_ctps_screened_at, when this screen stops being valid. Null when not screened. Screen the numbers you are supplied yourself before calling, and again every 28 days.

ContactRecord.description: One complete UK record: named email, telephone where held, postal address and company fields with Companies House number and SIC, plus the compliance object.

job_level.description: The level, such as Director; null when the level is not known.

job_level_rank.description: Rank on the 13-rank ladder, 1 (Owner) the most senior to 13 (Volunteer); null when the level is not known.

dataset_version.description: The immutable weekly build a count is bound to, such as 2026-W39. The last 52 stay queryable.

id.description: The record id, pushed to CRMs as mydatahub_record_id.

phone.description: Present when the field set includes telephone and a number is held.

Provenance.description: Source per entity, answering the ICO questions who compiled it and where from.

company.description: Where the company facts came from and the snapshot date.

contact.description: Who compiled the contact, when, and how it was last confirmed.

email.description: The latest email verification: date, provider result and location.

SicCode.description: A SIC 2007 code and its label, such as 25620 Machining.

outputSchema.description: The full record for a confident match, or no match at no charge.

already_licensed.description: True when you already hold the record, so it costs 0.

cost_gbp.description: The value of the credits charged, in GBP, plus VAT (VAT is not included in this figure; it is paid when credits are bought). Credits bought by card count at what their purchase cost, and card-bought credits are used oldest first; free trial credits count at 0; any other credits at your plan's rate (a new customer's rate on the free plan).

credits_remaining.description: Credits, to one decimal place: whole at 1 credit a record, fractional only where a rule is (0.1 company-only, 1.8 outright, both proposed).
